trap.label: dedução vs. futuro
trap.wrong: The lights are on, so he must be arrive.
trap.right: The lights are on, so he must have arrived.
trap.why: O brasileiro confunde o tempo: para deduzir algo que já aconteceu, use must have + particípio.

mcq.why: can't have known = tenho certeza de que não souberam.
Must have been: sem -s em have e com particípio.

mcq.q: Qual frase é uma dedução sobre o passado?
opts: He must have missed the train.
mcq.why: must have + particípio = certeza lógica sobre o passado.

mcq.q: A dedução negativa de "She was there" é...

fix.why: Depois de modal, use have, nunca has.
Modais não mudam e pedem have + particípio.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com can't have: “Tom was at home.” (impossível)
rewrite.answer: Tom can't have been at home.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com must have: “Anna lost her phone.”
rewrite.answer: Anna must have lost her phone.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva como dedução certa: “She was sick.”
